description: Native Yggdrasil-range address derivation corpus for the LICHEN 0200::/8 profile, plus one genuine upstream Go AddrForKey reference vector kept verbatim.

profiles.upstream_go_addr_for_key: Upstream yggdrasil-go algorithm: bit-invert the Ed25519 public key, count leading 1 bits into addr[1], drop the first 0 bit, then bit-pack the remainder into addr[2:16]. No hashing involved.
profiles.lichen_native_sha512: LICHEN native profile (spec/06-security.md §8.5, spec/03-addressing.md): addr[0]=0x02, addr[1:8]=SHA-512(pubkey)[0:7], addr[8:16]=IID=SHA-512(pubkey)[0:8] with the U/L bit (0x02) cleared. Binding invariant: lower 64 bits of the address MUST equal the IID.

divergence_note: The upstream Go anchor is NOT reproducible by the lichen_native_sha512 profile and vice versa: upstream bit-packs the inverted key with no hash, while LICHEN derives from SHA-512. The two schemes agree only on the leading 0x02 byte. All lichen_native vectors below are cross-checked across the Python oracle (lichen.crypto.identity.yggdrasil_address), Rust (lichen-core::addr::ygg_addr_from_pubkey), C (lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519), and sibling files test/vectors/yggdrasil.json and test/vectors/yggdrasil-derivation.json where noted.

vectors.name: lichen_repeated_02_key_ul_forced_clear
vectors.note: SHA-512(pubkey)[0]=0xaa; U/L bit (0x02) must be cleared to 0xa8 in the IID

vectors.name: lichen_repeated_01_key_ul_naturally_clear
vectors.note: SHA-512(pubkey)[0]=0x5c; U/L bit already clear, IID unchanged by masking

vectors.note: single bit set at position 128 (MSB of byte 16, midpoint of the key)

vectors.name: lichen_bit_last_set_key
